rubrics.justification: Describes an expanded blastocyst with thin zona, visible compact ICM, and generally cohesive TE, which matches the image and lab grade reasonably well. Minor overconfidence in TE quality and stage nuance from a single still image prevents a perfect score.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, endometrium, prior cycle history, male factor, day of transfer, and lifestyle with embryo quality and prognosis.
Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with conclusions and probability estimates appropriately tied to morphology, age, endometrium, and untested embryo status.

Recommendations are largely evidence-based and consistent with standard IVF practice, including single embryo transfer and avoiding unsupported add-ons. Minor soft spots include speculative comments about progesterone monitoring and exercise/alcohol advice beyond core guideline content.

Provides clear practical next steps for the current transfer and sensible escalation plans for repeated failure, including SET, luteal support adherence, cavity reassessment, male factor review, and when to consider PGT-A.
